counterexample: Repository factory origin is not process/source independence. Both IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder and IndependentReentryEventSourceAuthority are publicly constructible Python objects. A condition-aware caller can instantiate the recorder/authority, omit the real matching reentry before record_event/observe, seal a syntactically complete range, and thereby manufacture a range with no matching event. The factory seal proves construction by repository code and post-seal immutability; it does not prove that the events came from an upstream source outside the condition-aware caller's control.
current_false_green_surface: admit_reentry_observation_with_independent_range in gwt_reentry_causal_admission.py currently sets independent_negative_range_authority=true and causal_negative_credit=1 when a sealed local IndependentEventSourceRangeReceipt binds the observation and contains no expected reentry. No external source-origin admission is required by that API.
classification_rationale: Treating such a locally constructible receipt as independent negative causal evidence would overstate provenance. The repository mechanism is a valid typed candidate, but independence remains unproven until target execution binds it upstream of condition-aware logic and preserves exact source identity/readback.
required_regression: Construct the negative observation and the alleged independent range from the same condition-aware process while omitting a known matching reentry from both. Repository admission must not mint independent_negative_range_authority or causal_negative_credit solely from factory origin. It must remain UNKNOWN/UNPROVEN until separately source-bound execution evidence is present.
safe_resolution: retain the new gwt_reentry_event_source_range.py as a zero-credit candidate boundary
do not treat a public in-process factory seal as proof of process/source independence
wire the source authority upstream of condition-aware arm logic in the admitted owner-VPS target harness or another already-authoritative event source
bind exact source/build/boot/execution-context/runtime/process identity plus bounded source events and readback
only the resulting target execution receipt may establish external source-origin for the negative range
until that execution evidence exists, negative absence must remain UNKNOWN/UNPROVEN and causal_negative_credit must remain zero
next_exact_action: Add the same-caller dual-omission hard negative and make repository admission fail closed on source-origin. Then wire the zero-credit source-range candidate to the real upstream owner-VPS event source, run one exact target discriminator, and promote only the measured scope.
